description:
## 1.36.0-dev.77 (2026-08-09)

- Reddit: choose the best available video candidate across playback, fallback, recursive, HLS, and DASH sources.
- Reddit: make T a distinct text-card preview and force-refresh missing post body text from selected post JSON.
- Reddit: prevent the G web modal overlay from taking focus while open.
- Reddit: improve G modal read-more/NSFW view handling without changing Reddit embed sizing.
